statistical_methods.paired: identical (model, task) instances, intersected applicable task IDs, primary budget 1024
statistical_methods.test: exact McNemar (two-sided binomial on discordant pairs)
statistical_methods.diff_ci: conservative Newcombe hybrid-score (correlation-ignoring); marginal Wilson 95% alongside
statistical_methods.equivalence: NO equivalence claims: no preregistered practical margins exist; overlapping CIs or p>=0.05 is reported as inconclusive
statistical_methods.budget_panel_note: budget curves vary TOTAL generation budget (max_tokens / n_predict), NOT the server reasoning budget; T2 (256 tokens) is the only reasoning-budget condition - reasoning-budget optimality is untested
